extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic-performance data are primarily in Figure 1 and text. Values read from plots are marked with qualifier '~'. Dense long-term stability data in Figure 1e contain many closely spaced scatter points over 110 h and were not digitized point-by-point; exact text reports only excellent stability, not individual conversion/selectivity/STY values. Supporting Information tables/figures (S3–S8, etc.) are cited but not provided in the input, so their additional numerical performance data were not extracted. The pristine UiO-36AA support run was described as negligible CO2 conversion and was not included as a support-only/no-product run.
